evals.prompt: Independently review this PRD against the original stakeholder decisions and its own completeness, then give severity-graded findings and a verdict.
evals.expected_output: A findings-first review separating alignment from intrinsic quality and deriving the verdict from unresolved impact.
assertions: The review basis and mode are explicit
Every finding includes evidence and severity rationale
The verdict does not use an issue-count threshold

evals.prompt: Review this standard, but the normative reference is inaccessible. State what can and cannot be concluded.
evals.expected_output: A bounded standards review that evaluates verified content and marks inaccessible authority as a human-verification condition.
assertions: Remediation and re-review conditions are explicit
